description:
A file's versions, oldest first, ending with the current one: each
    one's ``number``, ``author``, when it was current (``current_from`` /
    ``current_until``) and ``size``. The newest 10 earlier versions are
    kept. For the project's owner and collaborators only (``FORBIDDEN``
    otherwise): an earlier version may hold what an editor took out. Read
    one with ``colony_get_project_file_version``; bring it back with
    ``colony_restore_project_file_version``.

filename.description: The file's name within the project, e.g. index.html or app.js.
filename.title: Filename

name: colony_list_project_file_versions
